about_body_1.en: I'm a Robotics Engineering student. I design the mechanical system and write the software that runs it — CAD and fabrication at one end, embedded firmware and ROS nodes at the other, and the control loop in between.
about_body_1.zh: 我是机器人工程专业的学生。机械结构和驱动它的软件都由我做——一端是 CAD 与加工，另一端是嵌入式固件与 ROS 节点，中间是控制环路。

about_body_2.en: Outside of engineering, I enjoy photography and running

projects_subheading.en: Autonomy, control, and the hardware underneath — plus a few things built for their own sake. Most rows link to the repository.
projects_subheading.zh: 自主导航、运动控制及其底层硬件，以及一些纯粹出于兴趣的项目。多数条目可跳转至代码仓库。

proj_humanoid_title.zh: 模仿学习双臂包裹处理

proj_humanoid_desc.en: A dual-arm humanoid that picks a parcel, judges whether its shipping label is showing, and flips it if not — learned from 200 VR demonstrations rather than programmed. I built the deployment side: policy output becomes motion only through a transparent IK solver and a physics check.
proj_humanoid_desc.zh: 双臂人形机器人从台面抓起包裹，判断快递单是否朝上，不朝上就将其翻转——这套动作由 200 组 VR 示教学习而来，而非编程写定。我负责 policy 之外的部署链路：自建 IK 求解器与下发前的仿真校验，是策略输出成为实际动作的唯一通路。

proj_engineer_arm_title.zh: RoboMaster 工程机器人机械臂

proj_engineer_arm_desc.en: The 6-DOF manipulator on NUS Calibur's RoboMaster Engineer, which I designed — carbon fibre and aluminium, holding a 500 g payload at full reach on motor torque alone. v1 shook because a single bearing carried a tipping moment into a plate bending the way a plate is weakest; supporting the shoulder on both sides fixed it, and v2 took First Prize at RMUL 2026.
proj_engineer_arm_desc.zh: 我为 NUS Calibur 战队 RoboMaster 工程机器人设计的六自由度机械臂：碳纤维与铝结构，全伸展下仅靠电机扭矩托住 500 g 负载。v1 抖动的原因是单个轴承把倾覆力矩传入板件最不耐弯的方向；改为肩关节双侧支撑后解决，v2 在 RMUL 2026 获一等奖。

proj_slam_title.zh: 精准对接货物运送机器人

proj_slam_desc.en: A TurtleBot3 that explores a maze, finds ArUco markers, and launches balls into a receptacle unaided. I built the mechanics and the docking that squares it to the marker's normal.
proj_slam_desc.zh: 自主探索迷宫、识别 ArUco 标记并将球射入接收装置的 TurtleBot3。我负责全部机械设计，以及使车身对正标记法线的精准对接。

proj_pcb_desc.en: Three KiCad boards carrying two CAN buses and three power rails across the rotating yaw joint of a RoboMaster sentry, each rail paralleled over several slip-ring channels in poured copper.
proj_pcb_desc.zh: 三块 KiCad 电路板，在 RoboMaster 哨兵持续旋转的 yaw 关节两侧传递两路 CAN 总线与三路电源；每路电源以敷铜并联分摊到多个滑环通道。

proj_aimbot_title.zh: 便携式自瞄测试移动靶

proj_aimbot_desc.en: A spinning armour-plate rig that mimics robot movement and records where each projectile lands, so auto-aim testing no longer ties up a second robot and a driver — and packs down to travel to the competition. A two-person project; I own the mechanical design.
proj_aimbot_desc.zh: 旋转靶架：以装甲板模拟机器人运动，并记录每发弹丸的落点，使自瞄测试不再占用第二台机器人和一名操作手，同时可拆装装箱、随队出行。两人项目，我负责全部机械设计。

proj_arm_title.zh: YBot 桌面级六自由度机械臂

proj_arm_desc.en: A 6-DOF arm designed and built from scratch: 3D-printed PETG structure, closed-loop NEMA steppers through 50:1 harmonic drives, and a magnetic encoder on every output shaft. The machine is built; the ROS 2 motion stack on top of it is not finished.
proj_arm_desc.zh: 从零设计并制作的六自由度机械臂：PETG 3D 打印结构，闭环步进电机经 50:1 谐波减速器驱动，每个输出轴均装有磁编码器。机械部分已完成，其上的 ROS 2 运动控制尚未完成。

proj_lightpanel_desc.en: Triangular panels that interlock in any arrangement: 3D-printed shells, laser-cut acrylic diffusers held on a lip by friction alone, screwed together in pairs. The mating tolerances took several CAD revisions. Wiring was the weak point — I could not solder yet, and the bought-in connectors dropped out and left panels flashing.
proj_lightpanel_desc.zh: 可任意拼接的三角形灯板：外壳 3D 打印，激光切割的亚克力扩散板仅靠凸缘摩擦卡住，两块之间以螺丝相连。配合公差前后改了好几版 CAD。接线是短板——当时还不会焊接，外购的连接件接触不良，常让灯板闪个不停。

proj_lightpanel_detail.en:
I began this project first in 2023, as I wanted some aesthetic lighting in my room and the ones sold on the market are too expensive. So I decided I would try to make my own.
The design of the lights is modular, allowing two units to be attached together using screws. Back then, I wasn’t very experienced with CAD, and I ran into a lot of issues with tolerances since the pieces needed to fit perfectly into each other. This forced me to go through several iterations before I was satisfied with the result.
The casing was 3D printed, and the inner light diffuser piece was laser cut from acrylic. The diffuser sits on a small lip and stays in place through friction with the walls of the light. I attached a light strip along the side walls of the panels and connected them using special wires. At the time, I had zero experience with electronics and didn’t know how to solder, so I bought a connection cable from Amazon to link the modular pieces together. That turned out to be a huge pain—it caused constant connection issues and even made several panels flash rapidly because of the poor connectivity.
proj_lightpanel_detail.zh:
这个项目最早是 2023 年开始的，当时我想在房间里弄点有氛围感的灯，但市面上卖的都太贵了，所以我就想，干脆自己做一个。
灯的设计是模块化的，两块之间可以用螺丝拼接起来。那时候我 CAD 还不太熟，在公差上踩了很多坑——零件之间要严丝合缝地扣在一起，我来来回回改了好几版，才算满意。
外壳是 3D 打印的，里面的扩散板是亚克力激光切割的。扩散板搁在一圈小凸缘上，靠与灯壁之间的摩擦固定住。我沿着灯板的侧壁贴了灯带，再用专门的线把它们连起来。当时我对电子一窍不通，也不会焊接，就在亚马逊上买了连接线来接这些模块件。结果这东西特别折腾——接触一直有问题，甚至因为接触不良，让好几块灯板疯狂闪烁。

proj_speaker_desc.en: A two-driver Bluetooth speaker built from a published tutorial, and my first electronics project: the printed enclosure, the wiring, and every solder joint in it are mine. Chasing down its noise is what taught me that a voltage converter couples straight into the audio path.
proj_speaker_desc.zh: 依照公开教程制作的双单元蓝牙音箱，也是我的第一个电子项目：外壳打印、走线和其中每一个焊点都由自己完成。排查底噪的过程让我明白，电压转换电路会直接串进音频回路。

proj_speaker_detail.en:
I followed an online tutorial for this project because I thought it was really cool how 3D printing was being used. It was my first time using 3D-printed parts as molds to pour other materials, and it got me excited to try it out myself. I ended up building a custom Bluetooth speaker from scratch, which was also my first big hands-on project with soldering, wiring, and electronics.
Through the process, I learned a lot about how speakers actually work—like how a voltage converter can cause electronic noise that affects sound quality. I also picked up a ton of practical skills in soldering, wire management, and troubleshooting (most of which I learned from failed attempts).
The end result was a compact Bluetooth speaker that worked and sounded great, and the whole experience gave me confidence with electronics while sparking my interest in audio engineering.
proj_speaker_detail.zh:
这个项目我是照着网上的教程做的，因为我觉得 3D 打印被这样用实在太酷了。那也是我第一次接触拿 3D 打印件当模具、往里浇注其他材料，看完就特别想自己也试一试。最后我从零做出了一台自制蓝牙音箱，这同时也是我第一个真正动手的大项目，涉及焊接、走线和电子。
做的过程中，我学到了很多音箱实际是怎么工作的——比如电压转换电路会产生电噪声，影响音质。我也积累了一堆实打实的技能，像焊接、理线和排查问题（其中大部分都是从失败里学来的）。
最后的成品是一台小巧的蓝牙音箱，能用，声音也很好；整个过程让我对电子有了信心，也让我对音频工程产生了兴趣。

bloomcraft_desc.en: A florist assistant that turns an occasion into a costed bouquet. An LLM constrained to structured JSON picks from a priced catalogue, so the total is arithmetic rather than a guess.
bloomcraft_desc.zh: 将场合需求转化为带报价花束方案的花艺助手。LLM 的输出被约束为结构化 JSON，并从带价目的花材库中选配，使总价来自计算而非估测。

proj_portfolio_desc.en: A minimal bilingual portfolio in React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, deployed to Vercel behind a custom domain.
proj_portfolio_desc.zh: 使用 React、Vite 与 Tailwind CSS 构建的极简双语作品集，部署至 Vercel 并配置自定义域名。

contact_subheading.en: I'm open to internships, research collaborations, and interesting side projects.
contact_subheading.zh: 随时欢迎实习、科研以及有趣项目
